summary: PJM posts the agenda for the 290th Members Committee meeting on October 28, 2026. It lists standing reports and a Board discussion with stakeholders, and has no separate item on the large load show cause order.

points.point: The meeting runs 11:50 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. EPT in Audubon, PA, with administration, a consent agenda and reports.
points.quote: Members Committee Two Hundred Ninetieth Meeting PJM Conference and Training Center, Audubon, PA October 28, 2026

points.point: A regulatory activities report from Chris Holt is scheduled among the PJM reports.
points.quote: Chris Holt will review PJM’s regulatory activities report.

points.point: A Board discussion with stakeholders covers short-term priorities for PJM and the stakeholder process.
points.quote: Jason Barker will facilitate stakeholder feedback and dialog with the PJM Board regarding short term priorities for PJM and the stakeholder process.

points.point: A Special Members Committee meeting follows on November 5, 2026 at 2:15 p.m.

throughLine.text: Stakeholder calendar entry from the period when PJM prepares its E-7 show cause response, due November 16, 2026. It names no show cause item; the November 5 Special MC dates the consultation on PJM's planned filings.
